test_plan_for_future_implementation.goal: Verify that a future LangGraph parity runtime produces identical observable behavior to NativeAgentRuntimeV2 for the same inputs, while keeping native canonical by default.

tests.name: LangGraph state graph compiles
tests.assertion: StateGraph compiles without errors and graph.invoke accepts a goal string.

tests.name: create_run node produces valid run.json schema
tests.assertion: run_id prefixed with agv2_, status created, mode normalized, checkpoint.json exists.

tests.name: select_route node returns same route as native for sample goals
tests.assertion: Routes for 'hello', 'apply patch', 'what is status of brain gate', and 'valida candidato X' match native.

tests.name: execute_tools node uses ToolGatewayV2 and blocks writes in read_only
tests.assertion: file_patch_apply_approval_required returns blocked=true in read_only mode; read-only tools return ok=true.

tests.name: capability_metadata derivation matches native helper
tests.assertion: All 14 required keys present and values semantically equal for a fixed run state.

tests.name: Full graph run for direct_assistant route
tests.assertion: Returns final_answer and capability_metadata; planner_used=false, memory_used=false, intent_route=direct_assistant.

tests.name: Full graph run for brain_evidence route
tests.assertion: evidence_routed=true, tools_executed >= 1, trace_events_count >= 5, capability_metadata has all keys.

tests.name: Full graph run for operational_agent with write intent
Pause and resume via checkpoint.json
tests.assertion: After pause, checkpoint.json status is paused; after resume, status becomes completed.

tests.name: Parity smoke test: native vs langgraph for same message
tests.assertion: With AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity, response capability_metadata equals native capability_metadata for the same goal (keys and semantics).

tests.name: Default backend remains native
tests.assertion: Without flag, backend is native_runtime and class is NativeAgentRuntimeV2.

tests.name: Governance preserved under parity backend
tests.assertion: Write intent in read_only mode returns mode_escalation_required=true and blocked tools.

acceptance_criteria: All unit and integration tests pass with mocked finalizer.
Smoke parity test passes when comparing native and parity backends for the same goal.
No production route wiring changes unless AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity is explicitly set.
capability_metadata keys are identical between backends.
Governance blocks are identical between backends for write-intent probes.
